response.sql: WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM execution_counts), differences AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_difference DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM differences) SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_difference FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 10 ORDER BY share_difference DESC NULLS LAST, ordersmark NULLS LAST;
